args.evidence: raw.orders has 16,200 rows but only 15,000 distinct o_orderkey values; many order_key values appear twice with identical column values (e.g., o_orderkey=195). stg_orders simply selects from raw.orders, so duplicates flow downstream, causing unique_stg_orders_order_key to fail with 1,200 duplicate rows. Since duplicates are exact copies, they can be removed by deduplication in the staging model (SELECT DISTINCT) without data loss.
